_about: Plain-word lines for every Definition of Ready item (file 2, OS-09 v2) plus the S3 rules. 'plain' is what Matt and the Notion Missing Items field show. 'short' fills {top_item} in a reminder; 'where' fills {where_to_find}; 'still_needed' is the line used in a Template 1 'Still needed' slot. Only entries with approved: true may reach a client. Lines marked approved: false were drafted by the engine build on 19 Oct and NEED MATT'S WRITTEN APPROVAL by Fri 30 Oct 12:00; until then any row needing them stalls amber (S1 r7), never silently.

kickoff.plain: Kickoff not done (call or written kickoff form returned by the signer).

kickoff_form_returned.plain: Written kickoff form sent but not returned.
kickoff_form_returned.where: in the kickoff email I sent you

onboarding_form.short: the rest of your onboarding form

voice.plain: Voice missing: 'I' or 'we', plus words they use and words they never use.
voice.short: whether you say "I" or "we", and words you do and don't use

facts_in_writing.plain: Facts not confirmed in writing: years in the trade, guarantee, training, insurance.
facts_in_writing.short: your years in the trade, guarantee, training and insurance, in your words

areas.plain: Areas list or footer line missing.

photos.plain: Fewer than 8 usable, labelled photos (or exclusions not stated).

photo_exclusions.plain: Photos not to show: not answered ("none" is a valid answer).
photo_exclusions.short: any photos you don't want shown

legal_identity.plain: Legal name, company number, or registered office / 'service area only' missing.
legal_identity.short: your registered business name and company number

ico.plain: ICO number missing (blocks Gate B only).
ico.still_needed: Have you paid the ICO's yearly data protection fee? If you're not sure, the ICO website has a short online check. Send me the result.

gbp_url.plain: Full Google Business Profile URL missing (a share.google short link doesn't count).
gbp_url.short: the full link to your Google Business Profile

enquiry_routing.plain: Where enquiries go (email and mobile) or the funnel URL missing.
enquiry_routing.short: the email and mobile where enquiries should go

registrar.plain: Registrar not recorded, or DNS call not booked.
registrar.short: who your domain is registered with

dates_agreed.plain: Preview, feedback and launch dates not agreed.

baseline.plain: Baseline numbers missing (enquiries a month, % that become jobs, average job value, or 'unknown').

trading_name.plain: More than one trading name: the one the site uses isn't in the signer's writing yet.

short_answer.plain: Answer under 5 words for a copy field: counts as missing (S3 r7).

logo.plain: No logo file: clean text version used.
logo.still_needed: If you have your logo as a file, reply with it. If not, I'll set your name in clean type and you can swap it in later.

logo_png.plain: SVG logo conversion failed: PNG asked for.
logo_png.still_needed: Could you send the logo as a PNG? A photo or screenshot of it is fine too.

photo_origin.plain: Photo origin not confirmed in writing (no camera data, stock or supplier look).
photo_origin.still_needed: Quick check: were these all done by you or your team at {business}? I can only show your own work.

per_field_questions._about: S1 r4 / S3 r7: one fixed question per form field, approved by Matt before 30 Oct. NONE APPROVED YET. Drafts below need Matt.

team_description.question: Who does the work: just you, or a team? A sentence or two is plenty.

what_makes_you_different.question: What do your customers say you do better than others? A sentence or two in your own words.

services.question: Which jobs do you want more of? List them in your own words.
